crossRefs.note: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

translations.web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
translations.bsb: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.
translations.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
translations.asv: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
